scenarios.notes: Dashboard renders fully Bulma-styled with 6 stat tiles and 3 task cards; zero off-host requests; zero 404s on /static/*.

Navigated through every page in the Page Inventory. Embedded assets (bulma.min.css, app.css, alpine.csp.min.js, log-viewer.js, main.js, sprite.svg, favicon.ico) all served from localhost:18080 with Content-Type intact; zero off-host.

Taskfile + configs contain zero Node references (`grep -ni 'node|npm|npx' Taskfile.yml configs/*.yaml` returns empty). `task build-all` succeeds; no Tailwind binary, no `tailwind.config.js`, no `tools/` directory in repo.
Login form submits with `e2e-admin`/`e2e-password!`, lands on /. Six stat tiles and three task cards (`echo-ok`, `fail-task`, `multi-step`) present and styled.
Clicking Run Task POSTs /tasks/echo-ok/execute and navigates to /logs/<id>; LogViewer renders 10 log lines; final status badge reads 'success'.
Completed-execution view uses LogViewer pagination (level filter + Prev/Next/First/Last + page-size select + Jump-to-line input). All controls render with Bulma classes; no inline styles.
Clicking 'Sign out' in the navbar POSTs /logout, redirects to /login.
After sign-out, GET / redirects to /login; session is cleared.
Typography uses Bulma's system font stack; primary buttons share `.button.is-primary` styling; status badges use `.tag.is-success/-danger/-info/-warning`.
At 375x812: login mainScrollWidth=375, dashboard mainScrollWidth=375, task_detail mainScrollWidth=375 (after dropping `level is-mobile` modifier). All ≤ innerWidth (375).

`runrun-focus-ring` and `:focus-visible` styles in app.css apply to .button, .input, .select select, .pagination-link, .navbar-item, .navbar-burger, and `a`. Verified by inspection of the embedded app.css.

Invalid-credentials error renders as `<div class='notification is-danger is-light'>` with explicit corrective-action text ('Check your username and password'). WebSocket-lost banner is wired as a sticky `.notification.is-warning` with a Reconnect button (data-action='ws-reconnect').
Procedure executed end-to-end via the `playwright-cli` skill against ./runrun started with configs/playwright-test.yaml.

First run caught three CSP violations from inline `style='...'` attributes in templ files plus one residual `style='width:7rem'` in log-viewer.js. Procedure flagged the failure with URL+console output; after fixing (utility classes in app.css + DOM API-only style changes), follow-up run reports zero violations.
performance.getEntriesByType('resource') across the dashboard load lists 7 resources, all under localhost:18080; zero 4xx/5xx on /static/* responses.
